pages.text: $(thing)Coffee$() is made from the cherries of the $(thing)Coffee Tree$(), which grows in hot, tropical climates. Wild coffee trees must be at least 2 years old before they bear fruit. Trees grown in a $(l:firmalife/planters)Bonsai Planter$() inside a $(l:firmalife/greenhouse)Greenhouse$() fruit immediately.

$(thing)Production Chain$():$(br)$(li)Dry coffee cherries on a $(l:firmalife/drying)Drying Mat$()$(li)Remove the pulp from the coffee cherry with a $(thing)Knife$() to extract raw beans$(li)Dry raw beans on a drying mat$(li)Heat dried beans carefully to roast them — listen for the crackle!$(li)Grind roasted beans in a $(l:crafting/quern)Quern$()

$(bold)Roasting Tips$(): The beans go through two stages of heating. The first stage (around 200°C) roasts them properly. If heated further (past 400°C), they burn! A careful touch is needed.$(br2)Grinding roasted beans requires a $(l:crafting/quern)Quern$() with a handstone.

$(thing)Brewing$(): Place ground coffee in a $(thing)Pot$() with fresh water and heat.$(br)$(li)1 ground coffee + 500 mB water = Coffee$(li)2 ground coffee + 500 mB water = Strong Coffee$(br2)$(thing)Coffee with Milk$(): Mix coffee with milk (100 mB per 500 mB coffee) in a $(thing)Barrel$().
